title: Unifying and Beyond the Theory of Pervasive Capability Degradation in LLM Post-training SFT from Feature Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.05003v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pervasive Capability Degradation (PCD) refers to the phenomenon in which supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while adapting a large language model (LLM) to a target task, often erodes the general capabilities acquired during pre-training. Prevailing explanations attribute PCD to macroscopic distribution shift and therefore lack microscopic manipulability, leaving existing mitigation methods without a complete theoretical foundation. In this paper, we first develop a bottom-up geometric theory of PCD grounded in feature interference under superposition: narrow-domain SFT data disrupt the almost-orthogonal feature structure formed during pre-training, and the resulting interference drives activations across decision hyperplanes in the output Laguerre-Voronoi geometry, flipping predictions on general tasks. translated_title: 统一并超越：从特征干扰视角看大语言模型后训练SFT中普遍性能力退化的理论
translated_abstract: 普遍性能力退化是指监督微调在使大语言模型适应目标任务的过程中，往往会侵蚀模型在预训练阶段所习得的通用能力的现象。主流解释将PCD归因于宏观的分布偏移，因而缺乏微观层面的可操作性，导致现有的缓解方法缺乏完整的理论基础。在本文中，我们首先基于叠加态下的特征干扰，建立了一个自底向上的PCD几何理论：窄域SFT数据破坏了预训练期间形成的近正交特征结构，由此产生的干扰使激活值越过输出Laguerre-Voronoi几何中的决策超平面，从而翻转通用任务上的预测。该理论将现有方法统一为六种范式，并揭示了这些方法有效性的来源及其局限性。随后我们主张……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于叠加态下特征干扰的自底向上几何理论，从微观机制解释了大语言模型SFT中普遍性能力退化的成因，并将现有缓解方法统一为六种范式，同时揭示了其有效性的来源与局限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a bottom-up geometric theory of Pervasive Capability Degradation (PCD) in LLM SFT grounded in feature interference under superposition, explaining the microscopic mechanism of capability loss and unifying existing mitigation methods into six paradigms while revealing both their efficacy sources and limitations.
